named_events.loss_description: The claims on these events, while large, were not outside of expectation for such types of natural catastrophes.

Hurricane Michael became the strongest storm ever to hit the Florida panhandle ... For our reinsurance book, Michael was the more expensive storm, generating reinsurance losses of about half those of Hurricane Irma in 2017.
We accordingly incurred a share of the reinsurance losses from Typhoon Jebi in September, the most severe storm to make landfall in Japan since 1993.
We accordingly incurred a share of the reinsurance losses ... from Typhoon Trami, which hit the south of the country a few weeks later.
Wildfire losses in 2018 look likely to exceed this figure [2017]; Beazley's share of this loss is currently estimated at $40m.
The cost of previous year's catastrophes, notably Hurricane Irma, rose and combined with fresh losses from Hurricanes Michael and Florence in the US.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (31/12/2017) was $753.9m. Management report that they were able to release prior year reserves of $25.1m in 2018 (2017: $39.7m), driven primarily by favourable claims development across most divisions, although property saw adverse prior-year development. The combined effect was a net prior-year release, reducing carried reserves versus the opening balance. Major 2018 natural catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Florence and Michael, Typhoons Jebi and Trami and California wildfires) affected current-year claims and reinsurance; wildfire losses were specifically estimated at Beazley share $40.0m.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding $753.9m). Prior-year movement taken from Managing Agent narrative 'released prior year reserves of $25.1m' (page 4). The report does not present a clear gross-only 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note; the $25.1m figure in the narrative may be net or gross (report does not explicitly label it gross), so the prior_year_development figure is flagged with lower confidence. Detailed claims development triangle exists in the Technical Provisions notes but the full development-period numeric triangle was not fully extracted here; therefore the triangle was not used to recompute prior year development. LOB mappings from divisional table to standard Lloyd's LOBs are best-effort approximations.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table is present in the Technical Provisions notes (pages ~46-50) including gross ultimate % by development age and gross claims liabilities by underwriting year. The detailed development-period numeric rows were not transcribed into this JSON; users should consult the report pages referenced for the full triangle if required.
